title: Make producer and validator agree on unknown usage (failing test first)
goal: A report the engine writes is a report the engine accepts
acceptance: The T01 failing test passes after the fix, which changes one side only (the producer sets usage null when any model result is an error, or the validator rule is relaxed with the reason recorded); no existing test edited to pass
A report that mixes a non-null total with errored or timed-out results is either never written or accepted, and the ledger command no longer refuses a report the same engine produced
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git; no private reports or consumer data.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-27 at agent speed. Not a measurement.
